For a 50-person Indian company, the practical comparison is:

Provider	Current pricing	Key exclusions / watch-outs	Best for
MMT myBiz	No fixed subscription publicly listed; service fee is agreed in the order form. 1.5% payment-gateway fee applies to card/e-wallet payments. 
MakeMyTrip
	Booking/service fees, fare-rule cancellation/reissue charges; special free-change/cancellation fares have conditions. 
MakeMyTrip Biz
	SMEs wanting self-serve + GST + approvals
Cleartrip OOO	₹0 subscription; no extra platform charges publicly advertised. 
OOO
	Confirm cancellation/reissue charges, support SLA and whether negotiated corporate fares cover your routes.	Low-cost, simple corporate booking
Thomas Cook India	Custom quote; no public standard per-booking price.	Dedicated servicing/implant, 24×7 support and broader services depend on contracted package. 
Thomas Cook
	Hands-on managed travel + visa/forex/MICE
FCM India	Custom quote; pricing not publicly disclosed.	Confirm management fee, transaction fees, implementation and after-hours charges.	Higher-volume / international travel programs

For your 50-person setup: ask all four for an annual all-in ₹ quote based on your expected flight/hotel spend. Compare transaction fee + GST + cancellation/reissue + support + payment fees, not subscription price alone. MMT's corporate business surpassed $1B bookings in 2025, indicating substantial scale in India.
